description: ⚠️⚠️ a React component ends up in the payload that crosses the boundary: exactly the defect that took the dashboard away from everybody in production, and that was invisible in development
replace:
locked[entry.url] = entry.module;
      (locked as unknown as Record<string, unknown>)[`${entry.url}:icon`] = (entry as { icon?: unknown }).icon;

description: ⚠️ an entry the role does not allow stays in the menu: a viewer sees Users and Settings and is bounced without a word
⚠️ a module outside the plan is hidden rather than shown with a lock: the product's only invitation to upgrade disappears
with no plan known everything is locked: a workspace whose entitlements fail to load loses half its menu
sub-items are no longer evaluated: Billing and Webhooks stay visible to somebody who cannot open them
the client-side filter ignores the list of hidden urls: the server decides and nobody applies it
⚠️⚠️ the bottom bar is built from the unfiltered menu: a viewer gets a tab straight to Users, and the one permission rule now has a second, quieter copy that disagrees with it
a module outside the plan takes a slot in the bottom bar: a quarter of the phone's navigation goes to a page that does not open
the bottom bar draws from the account menu too: Settings and the help centre compete for the four slots a phone has
